core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Haafiz corresponds to the Arabic form حافظ (Arabic root ح ف ظ (ḥ-f-ẓ); حافظ (Ḥāfiẓ)). Its core sense is protector, guardian, preserver. Haafiz is Arabic حافظ (Ḥāfiẓ) 'guardian, preserver, keeper', the active participle of the root ح ف ظ (ḥ-f-ẓ) 'to guard, preserve'. It is a divine name (al-Ḥafīẓ) and, in Muslim usage, the title of one who has memorised the whole Qur'an. The word حفيظ appears in the Qur'an (e.g. 12:64); the use as a title for a Qur'an-memoriser is a later usage, noted as such.
